run_sample_main: run the sample.main function to generate sequences from a trained transformer grammars model
run_sample_with_checkpoint: run the sample module with a checkpoint path to load a trained model for sampling
run_sample_with_input: run the sample module with a tokenized TSV input file containing sequences to score
run_sample_with_temperature: run the sample module with a configurable temperature for controlling sampling randomness
run_sample_with_seed: run the sample module with a PRNG seed for reproducible sampling output
